sentences.text: Alexander disease is linked to the gene GFAP in curated databases, with no contradicting evidence [e_04bd923155c0].
Two features are recorded as observed in a database for Alexander disease, a tremor of the soft palate and an unusually small pupil [e_91d4e3da3934] [e_672bf9232141].
Both observations rest on very small counts, shown as 1 of 1 in the records [e_91d4e3da3934] [e_672bf9232141].
Constellate also computed that Alexander disease looks somewhat like an adult-onset dominant demyelinating leukodystrophy in its listed symptoms [e_ad9a11398ea4].
That similarity is inferred, with a score of 0.216 (simGIC, a measure of shared symptom terms), and it is not a diagnosis [e_ad9a11398ea4].
These edges do not show how common the two features are in everyone with the disease [e_91d4e3da3934].
They also show no trials, funding or patient groups for Alexander disease [e_04bd923155c0].
